about.title: About me

That's why I came up with one base, three variations, a sweet treat as part of the plan, and an app that works out how much to eat.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: In short and in plain words: what happens with your data when you use the Niky's Kitchen website and the Jídlo od A–Z app.

sections.p: Niky's Kitchen is Niky's personal project, not a company. For questions about your data or to have it deleted, just reply to any email you get from us.

sections.h: What the website collects about you

sections.p: Only your email, and only if you enter it yourself: when you sign up for the newsletter or click “I'm interested” in the shop. The website has no accounts and uses no analytics or advertising tools.

ul: We store your email, what you signed up for (the newsletter or which product), the website language and the time.
Why: to send you the newsletter with the gift, or to tell you when a product is on sale. The legal basis is your consent, which you give by ticking the box.
The data passes through Make (servers in the EU) and is saved in a Google Sheet that only Niky can see. We never share or sell it.
How long: until you unsubscribe. You can unsubscribe with the link in every email or by replying to it. We then delete your email.
You have the right to know what we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, and to complain to the Czech data protection authority (uoou.gov.cz).

sections.p: Neither the website nor the app uses cookies. If we add visitor analytics, we'll ask you first with a consent banner and won't measure anything without your consent.

ul: Your profile (age, weight, height, goal), fridge and shopping list are stored only in your browser.
They are never sent anywhere and we can't see them.
To delete them, clear this site's data in your browser.

sections.p: The website and the app are hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). On every visit GitHub processes technical data such as your IP address to deliver the page and protect it from attacks. It follows its own privacy statement.
The website stores its fonts itself, nothing else is loaded. The app currently loads fonts from Google Fonts, so Google sees your device's IP address. We'll change this when we rebuild the app.
Since we store nothing about you, there's nothing to hand over, correct or delete. Once we start collecting data (newsletter, shop), we'll explain your GDPR rights here and how to use them.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.lead: We want everyone to be able to use the website, including people with visual, motor or other impairments.

sections.p: We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 at level AA. The website hasn't been independently audited yet, so we don't claim full compliance.

ul: The whole website works with a keyboard, and there's a “Skip to content” link at the top.
Text has enough contrast with the background (at least 4.5 : 1).
Images have descriptions for screen readers.
Allergens are marked with colour and a triangle icon, not colour alone.
Buttons are large enough for fingers (at least 44 px).
If your device has “reduce motion” turned on, animations are switched off.
Recipes can be printed or saved as PDF.
Pages are in Czech and English with the language set correctly for screen readers.
Some images are illustrations made with AI; we'll replace them with real photos.
PDF samples may not be fully accessible to screen readers.
We're rebuilding the Jídlo od A–Z app and will fine-tune its accessibility.

sections.p: Tell us what didn't work and on which page. We'll add a contact soon; until then you can reach Niky's Kitchen on social media.
